column1: # Covers Singapore-origin / Singapore-headquartered brands: airlines and transport, banks and investment firms,
# telecom, internet and apps, gaming hardware and audio, conglomerates and property, hotels and attractions,
# food and drink brands, restaurants and cafes, fashion, retail, media and newspapers.

# 찰스앤키스), else the English reading the brand uses (Malay/Chinese 외래어 표기법 where the name is not English).
